<p>Given a <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/namespaces/llvm/object/#acc360db994cbcc482937196bf406df98">relocation_iterator</a> for a non-scattered relocation, construct a <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/relocationentry">RelocationEntry</a> and fill in the common fields.</p>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Construct a <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/relocationvalueref">RelocationValueRef</a> representing the relocation target.</p>


<p>For Symbols in known sections, this will return a <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/relocationvalueref">RelocationValueRef</a> representing a (SectionID, Offset) pair. For Symbols whose section is not known, this will return a (SymbolName, Offset) pair, where the Offset is taken from the instruction immediate (held in RE.Addend). In both cases the Addend field is <em>NOT</em> fixed up to be PC-relative. That should be done by the caller where appropriate by calling makePCRel on the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/relocationvalueref">RelocationValueRef</a>.</p>
